name: io.github.BuildPulseLLC/buildpulse-mcp
title: BuildPulse
description: BuildPulse CI test analytics for AI agents — flaky tests, CI failures, flakiness, and code coverage.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDPULSE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: BuildPulse API token (`bp_<64-hex>`; legacy 40-hex tokens also accepted). Create one at buildpulse.io → Organization Settings → API Tokens.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the platform API base URL. Default: https://platform.buildpulse.io

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <BuildPulse API token> (`bp_<64-hex>`; legacy 40-hex tokens also accepted). Or use OAuth 2.1 — see /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server for the discovery document.
